purpose: Pattern Lab thumbnail typography policy for city-history packaging. Use Canva first when available; use open-license Fontsource/Chrome fallback when Canva is blocked.

city_anchor.purpose: Make the active city immediately clear at phone/search-shelf size.

main_hook.purpose: Carry the click question in 1-4 words without looking generic or amateur.

supporting_line.purpose: Clarify the proof/payoff only when it does not compete with the main hook.

document_prop.purpose: Only for readable source-file props, redaction props, or document visuals.

hard_blocks: Impact used as the main title when Avenir Next Condensed Heavy, Helvetica Neue Condensed Black, DIN Condensed Bold, or Arial Black is available
oversized black outline used as the main readability method
more than two public text families outside a document prop
font choice not recorded in the render report
main title unreadable at 320x180 or 160x90 shelf preview
shadow or stroke makes the text muddy
font choice copied from a competitor layout instead of translated into Pattern Lab's own source-first style
supporting line more than four public words without explicit owner approval
supporting line squeezed below the phone-readability threshold
SOURCE PHOTO, RECEIPT, or generic SOURCE FILE appears as public thumbnail text without a curiosity purpose
bare redaction bars appear without readable surrounding words
city or main-hook font family is outside the approved premium manifest
thumbnail has no 320x180 and 160x90 mobile shelf previews

successful_channel_patterns_to_translate.principle: Use large condensed text beside a concrete map/photo proof object.
successful_channel_patterns_to_translate.pattern_lab_rule: City name plus 1-4 word hook over a real city photo, map, or source-file object.

successful_channel_patterns_to_translate.principle: Use a high-contrast color block to make one word instantly legible.
successful_channel_patterns_to_translate.pattern_lab_rule: Use yellow/cyan blocks only when they clarify the proof object or city hook.

successful_channel_patterns_to_translate.principle: Use restrained, bold sans text over a recognizable real place image.
successful_channel_patterns_to_translate.pattern_lab_rule: No decorative labels; the word count must stay small and pay off in the first 30 seconds.

fallback_policy: Impact and generic system fonts are blocked for city/main hook when the approved Fontsource pack is installed.

blocked_if: supporting text is squeezed below the readability floor
supporting text exceeds four words without explicit owner approval
supporting text competes with the main hook instead of clarifying it

owner_reference_typography_traits: condensed heavy sans or expressive bold display feel
black outline or shadow only when it sharpens the letters
vivid color contrast rather than muted blue/gray default text
